I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I told her I couldn't confirm the 141-seat figure for the Moorland rollout at Marrow Fieldworks. Nothing she can see says either way: #central-team, the brain and the shared files don't mention the Moorland rollout or a seat count for it. The only record of the number is her own message from just now. I asked anyone with the contract, CRM record or a note from the customer to post it there.

A seat count is account information, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I also said I'd update the record once someone confirms the number, but I haven't actually written the 141 anywhere.
